name: Restrofood Lite – Online Food Ordering System
author: themelooks

sections.description:
RestroFood (Free & Pro) is an all-in-one Restaurant Management Plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce that helps food businesses manage online menus, WooCommerce food ordering, delivery, and takeaway, and a table reservation system from a single powerful dashboard. With online and offline POS management, multi-branch control, multi-delivery fees, automatic invoice printing, in-restaurant ordering, and tips management, RestroFood delivers a complete restaurant solution for WordPress built for restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, and online food delivery businesses.

🎥 Watch RestroFood WordPress Restaurant Plugin (Installation and Configuration, Admin, Settings) Overview

Explore All The Powerful WordPress Online Restaurant Management Features From RestroFood 👇

🔗Live Demo | 🔗Documentation | 🔗Features | 🔗Video Tutorials | 🔗Restaurant Free Theme | 🔗Upgrade To Pro

Need help setting up your online food ordering and restaurant management website? Contact Us

Who Can Benefit from RestroFood WordPress Restaurant Plugin?

Restaurants, cafés, bakeries, cloud kitchens, and all types of food businesses benefit from the RestroFood WordPress restaurant plugin. Because of this, all-in-one WooCommerce restaurant management system streamlines online food ordering, delivery & takeaway, table reservations, POS management, and multi-branch operations. RestroFood makes restaurant management simple, fast, and efficient.

➤ Small Restaurant Owners (online food ordering & takeaway setup)

➤ Medium Restaurant Owners (WooCommerce restaurant management)

➤ Large Restaurant Owners / Franchises (multi-branch restaurant system)

➤ Bar or Club (POS integration)

➤ Cafe (WordPress restaurant menu plugin & table booking system)

➤ Fine Dining Restaurants (table reservation & booking system)

➤ Casual Dining Restaurants (delivery & pickup ordering)

➤ Transportation Hub Food Outlets (fast online ordering system)

➤ Hotels (restaurant reservation & in-house ordering)

➤ Casino or Cruise Ship Dining (POS & order tracking system)

➤ Cloud or Ghost Kitchens (online food delivery system)

➤ Food Trucks (mobile food ordering & pickup)

➤ Bakeries & Dessert Shops (WooCommerce food ordering)

➤ Digital Dining Concepts (QR code food ordering)

➤ Street Food Vendors (simple online ordering system)

➤ Takeout / Takeaway Businesses (pickup-based ordering)

➤ Food Service Businesses (order & delivery management)

➤ Online Food Ordering Businesses (restaurant ordering system)

➤ Online Food Delivery Service Providers (multi-delivery fee system)

➤ Grocery Stores, Fruit & Vegetable Shops (local delivery ordering)

Challenges We Solve – Complete WordPress Restaurant Management & Online Ordering Solution 💪

Running a restaurant or food delivery business comes with many operational challenges, from managing online food orders and deliveries to handling table reservations, POS operations, and multi-branch management. RestroFood WordPress restaurant plugin is trusted by 1000+ food businesses to solve these problems with a complete WooCommerce restaurant management system.

➤ Problem: Managing online food orders manually is slow, error-prone, and hard to track.

Solve: Our WooCommerce online ordering plugin automates online food ordering, with real-time notifications, order tracking, estimated preparation times, and seamless WooCommerce integration for fast, accurate order fulfillment.

➤ Problem: Multi-branch operations make menu updates, delivery, and orders complicated.

Solve: Our multi-branch restaurant management system allows branch-specific menus, delivery zones, pickup times, custom fees, and independent dashboards for each branch.

➤ Problem: In-restaurant order management is chaotic, leading to mistakes and slow service.

Solve: Our in-restaurant order system, part of our WooCommerce restaurant plugin, supports single & multi-branch operations, table number assignments, real-time order tracking, and error reduction for smoother dining experiences.

➤ Problem: Table reservations lead to overbooking or no-shows.

Solve: Our restaurant table reservation system prevents overbooking and no-shows. It supports unlimited tables, branch-specific scheduling, reservation time slots, automated email notifications, and full reservation status management, making table booking smooth and reliable.

➤ Problem: Delivery and pickup logistics are hard to manage across locations.

Solve: Our multi-delivery fees system allows restaurants to set zip code–based, kilometer-based, and branch-specific delivery charges, configure delivery and pickup time slots, apply distance restrictions, and automate fee calculations. This ensures fast, accurate, and hassle-free order fulfillment for both owners and customers.

➤ Problem: Point of Sale operations require manual tracking and multiple systems.

Solve: Our restaurant POS system supports multiple counters, branch-based role assignments, online/offline POS operations, multiple payment methods, order holding, invoice generation, barcode scanning, and detailed reporting, streamlining in-restaurant sales and improving operational efficiency.

➤ Problem: Checkout issues can cause abandoned carts or missed tips.

Solve: Our restaurant checkout system features floating mini carts, same-page checkout, delivery/pickup selection, pre-orders, order scheduling, and a fully customizable tips system (by percentage or fixed amount), helping restaurants reduce cart abandonment and increase customer satisfaction.

➤ Problem: Managing menus and product offerings can be difficult and may look unprofessional without proper tools.

Solve: Our WooCommerce restaurant menu plugin supports all WordPress themes and page builders, offers menu templates, product extra options, nutrition info, multiple product layouts, and theme color customization, making it easy to create a professional, visually appealing menu for your restaurant or food business.

➤ Problem: Manual invoice printing slows down restaurant operations and increases errors.

Solve: Our automatic order invoice printing add-on supports PrintNode integration, supports multiple printers, thermal and standard formats, and allows customizable headers and footers for instant, error-free printing on every order.

➤ Problem: Lack of analytics makes decision-making difficult.

Solve: Our WordPress restaurant plugin provides detailed sales reports, real-time order statistics, and advanced filtering options. A comprehensive restaurant management dashboard helps optimize menus, pricing, staff allocation, and promotions for smarter, data-driven decisions.

RestroFood Lite (Free Version) – Core Features Every Restaurant Needs💪

RestroFood Lite (Free Version) is a WooCommerce restaurant management system that helps restaurants, cafés, and food businesses manage online orders and grow their business easily.

Easy WooCommerce Food Ordering System: RestroFood Lite offers an easy and free WooCommerce food ordering system, making online food ordering simple and fast. Manage menus, deliveries, and pickups all in one place.

Ajax Quick Product View: View product details instantly without leaving the page, making browsing faster and easier for your customers with our free restaurant plugin.

Ajax Quick Search: Search for anything on your restaurant website by typing the characters. Get the search result you’re looking for without loading the whole display page. It’s easier and faster for users to search for anything.

Ajax Category Filter: You can easily filter products (food visibility) and categories with the Ajax Category Filtering system. Helping customers navigate menus with ease and complete orders faster.

Ajax Pagination: Load more menu items instantly without refreshing pages using Ajax Pagination. Customers enjoy smooth browsing and can explore all offerings without delays.

Order Place Restriction on Minimum Order Amount Options: Set a minimum order amount so that customers have to order more than a certain amount. This system will help you keep track of your sales.

Order Received Page Customization Options: Customize the order received page to show the information you want and create a better experience for your customers.

Invitation Option in the Order Received Page: Add invitation options on the order received page to encourage customers to share or invite others, boosting engagement and orders.

Same Page Cart & Checkout System: Our same page cart & checkout system is so fast. You won’t have to click your mouse too many times to access the checkout page. Customers can complete orders from any page without extra clicks, making the shopping and checkout process quick and easy.

Delivery Type Select Option (Delivery/Pickup): This system allows customers to choose between delivery and pickup, giving them control over how and when they receive their orders.

Custom Delivery Fee Add Options: Using these features, you can set custom delivery fees based on distance, branch, or order type, ensuring accurate and fair pricing for each order.

Delivery Date and Time Set Options: It allows customers to schedule pre-orders within a set time frame. Two Types of delivery scheduling options: today’s delivery/pickup, and schedule delivery/pickup for another day.

Day-Based Delivery Time Set Options: Set specific delivery times for each day so that customers can pick times that work for them, and you can handle orders more easily using this system.

Break Time Adding Option In Delivery Time Slot: This option allows you to add break times within your delivery schedule. Customers cannot select these times for orders, helping you manage staff and kitchen workload efficiently.

Delivery Time Slot Settings: It allows you to configure delivery time slots according to your preferences. Set Opening Days, Holidays, Opening Time, Closing Time, Break Start, and End Time. Simply configure your business time management at ease.

Free Shipping Based on Order Amount: Automatically give free shipping when an order reaches a certain amount. This will encourage customers to buy more and make checkout easier and more rewarding.

All Kinds of Themes & Page Builders Are Supported: RestroFood works seamlessly with all kinds of themes and page builders that support shortcodes, including Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Visual Composer, Brave Builder, and Divi Builder, making setup simple and hassle-free.

Theme Color Change Options: Easily change your website theme colors to match your brand and create a unique look for your restaurant.

Support all WooCommerce Payment Gateways: RestroFood provides an efficient WooCommerce payment solution. It supports all types of WooCommerce payment gateways such as: Stripe, PayPal, Google Pay, Square, Amazon Pay, Alipay, Authorize.net, Apple Pay, etc.

Ready For Translation (.pot Files Included): Ready for Translation enables you to easily translate all texts using the included .pot files, allowing your restaurant to serve customers in any language with minimal effort.

Compatibility with WordPress 6+: Ensuring RestroFood runs smoothly with the latest WordPress versions for better performance, security, and stability.

Nice & Customizable Settings: RestroFood offers easy and customizable settings. Choose product grids in 2, 3, or 4 columns, and add product extras, add-ons, colors, and layouts to match your restaurant’s style.

Provides Shortcodes: With the [RestroFood_products] shortcode, you can easily display food items on your website. With RestroFood, you can now generate shortcodes to customize your page settings as needed.

Free Updates: Our restaurant plugin provides free updates, so your system stays up to date with the latest features, performance improvements, and security enhancements.

Error-Free Code: Built with clean, error-free code to ensure smooth performance, stability, and reliable operation.

Well Documented: Clear and easy-to-follow documentation that helps you set up, customize, and manage RestroFood without hassle. Step-by-step guides make everything simple, even for beginners.

RestroFood PRO – Everything Free + More Restaurant Management System 🏆

Free Theme Included: We provide a free theme for restaurants and food businesses’ websites to showcase menus, take online orders, deliver, and create a responsive website that attracts customers easily.

🔗Get Pro Now

6 Product Display Layout: We provide 6 different product layouts to showcase your restaurant menu items attractively. Highlight your dishes and make it easy for customers to browse and order.

3 Cart Style Included: We give you 3 unique cart style options, which are different cart styles that easily store product information, a perfect getaway for order, catalog, and customer management, and it gives product data, categories, and site information for user display.

Easy Order Management System: Our System makes order management easy with separate dashboards for shop owners, branch managers, kitchen managers, and delivery boys, to manage your orders easily. Also provides back-end/admin dashboards for shop owners.

Delivery Availability Checker: It helps you locate the delivery location availability using an address, zip code, branch, location, etc. You can check the delivery availability using an address, restaurant location, and zip code.

Product Extra Option: Create unlimited combo products with different product extra options and enable your customers to build their order and see the extended price instantly. Available with different styling options and an extended price calculator.

Invoice Print Options: Our wordpress restaurant plugin makes printing order invoices simple. You can print orders with just one click. It supports both thermal and receipt printers and also customizes the invoice header and footer sections.

Simple Delivery Management: We offer a simple delivery management system that makes food delivery and pickup easy. All options are available here: Delivery and Pickup, Only Delivery, Only Pickup. And you can select the mode of transport for delivery boys.

3 Types of Admin Panel: Our plugin has 3 types of dedicated admin panels. Each panel is very useful and effective for the respective admin manager. Separate admin panels for shop managers, kitchen managers, and delivery boys to manage their tasks easily.

Shop Manager Admin Panel: An individual admin panel has been added for the shop manager. The admin panel can be accessed with proper credentials.

Kitchen Manager Admin Panel: An individual admin panel is available for a kitchen manager so that he/she can track all the records and run the restaurant properly.

Delivery Man Admin Panel: Delivery boys can see and manage all their orders, check delivery details, track progress, and complete tasks easily.

Order Status Change Option: Email notification works on the order status. When the admin changes the order status, an email is automatically sent to customers to inform them of their order’s current status. If you cancel the order, it will notify you with a notification.

Closing Time Detection: Our restaurant plugin detects the closing time of your restaurant. You can set the opening and closing times for order delivery/pickup. Customers can set delivery and pickup times for both types of delivery options. It just needs to be within the restaurant’s open and closing times.

Order Limit On Time Slot: Setting up the order limit according to the time slot is easy with our plugin. You can limit the order to any particular time slot. If any time slot is full with orders, you can notify the customer to try another slot.

Break Time Adding Option In Delivery Time Slot: It allows you to add break times within your delivery schedule. Customers cannot select these times for orders, helping you manage staff and kitchen workload efficiently.

Zip Code-Based Delivery: Zip code based delivery feature allows you to set specific zip codes for delivery. Customers can enter their zip code to check if delivery is available. It’s making delivery accurate, fast, and hassle-free.

Demo Data Included: Theme and Demo Data are included with the RestroFood WooCommerce plugin. Just need to import the data and have fun! All things are there to manage your online food ordering & delivery system easily.

Add Nutrition Option: Our plugin lets you display nutrition facts like calories, protein, carbs, fat, sugar, and fiber for each menu item, helping customers make informed and healthier choices.

Quick Order Placement: It offers a one-click ordering system. Its one-click ordering makes online food ordering easy and fast, so you get your food instantly.

Pre-Order System: Allow customers to place orders in advance for a specific date and time, helping you prepare ahead and manage orders more smoothly

Order Scheduling System: Customers schedule their orders for a specific date and time, making it easier to manage preparations and deliveries efficiently.

sections.installation:
The easy way.

Go to your WordPress Dashboard. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and then search for “Restrofood Lite”. Click on Install and then Activate the Plugin.

That’s it, Restrofood Lite Plugin is now activated on your site!

The hard way..

Download “Restrofood Lite WordPress Plugin” and then extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation and then activate the Plugin from Plugins page.
